title: Example 130: a backoff that gained a multiplier, related to the doubling record by building it from the new components
description: Regression proof of net.terminalvalue.crosscut.retry.Backoff#delayMillis across a component added to the record: the previous two-component Backoff is built from the new one's base and cap by a constructor call among --before-arguments (new Backoff(this.baseMillis, this.capMillis), attempt), with this.multiplier != 2 as the scope. The loop rewritten to count down answers a negative attempt with the cap: expected a violation at attempt=-1, found in the second search stage in about 9 s inline.
